value.rationale: A single physical target on a ring has two distinguishable approach directions. The theorem classifies how many times reset intensity can reverse their probability ordering, proves exact sharpness for arbitrary prescribed rates and identifies the minimal three-site double-reversal mechanism. This is a natural design and interpretation question distinct from prior optimization of mean hitting time; a sharp complete result rather than arbitrary numeric fitting.
